on 2.4M USD. I see no scenario that the charity board and trustees will
approve this by tomorrow, in order to be executed by Saturday. Sir, if
you want to take advantage of my expreienced services in deal making you
will have to allow me (1) details of information you have, as this and

this process, to make sure that we are progressing as planned.
Respectfully, [redacted].
